book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Luka

content: Mabholu panani ja mahakau na kulekakela
Yesu akabhapwaghi bhabhulwa bhaki, “Anaipitalya hindu yamaheli yeyampelakya mundu kuhenga mahoku, nambu anaachibhonaje mundu jola joaghatenda ghapitalyaje!
Ikabya mbanga mundu hoju akongakika liganga la kuyaghila pahingu na kundeke mu bahali kuliku kuntenda jumu wa bhachoku abhabha atenda mahoku.
Kwa ndandi ajeji mulilendaje. “Ngati ndongu waku anaakuhokihi, undakalya, na anaang'anambwiki na kukotoka lihoku laki, undekakyaje.
Ngati anaakuhoki mala saba pa lichobha limu, na anaakelawiki mala saba na kupwagha, ‘Ng'anambwiki na kughaleka mahoku ghangu,’ upalika undekakyaje.”
Uhobhalelu
Mitumi bhaki bhakumpwaghi Bambo, “Utujonjukya uhobhalelu.”

Bambo akapwaghike, “Ngati uhobhalelu winu ukabhi uchoku hata ngati imbeju njoku ja haladali, mukabya muweziki kuupwaghi nkongu wa mtini aghoghu, ‘Utupukaje, na ukalipanda mubahali,’ nawombi ukabya unjetakile.
Mahengu ghaka mtumika

“Tupwagha jumu winu abhi na mundu joandemela mungonda au kundimila mambeleli ghaki. Muhenga lihengu jola paahika kuhuma kungonda, bho, aweza le kumpwaghi, ‘Uhika kinyata, utama pahi, na ukula chilebhe?’
Ngabhela! Jombi anampwaghila, ‘Kutumbula ndelakya chilebhi na undumakya mbaka panijomula kula na kunywa, na panihapa nde uweza kula na kunywa!’
Bho, ngaanchenguli mtumika hoju kwa ndandi ahengiki ghala ghaandaghalakile?
Bhelabhela nanamu ananjomwi kuhenga kila chindu chechumpalika kuhenga, mpwagha, ‘Tepani twa bhatumika pela twanga na nyonjeka, tuhengiki pe ghaghapalika tuhengaje.’ ”
Yesu alamiha bhandu komi
Yesu paakabhi mumwanja wa kujenda ku Yelusalemu, akapetiki mukulindakani mwa muchi wa Samalia na wa Galilaya.
Paakabhi ajingi mu chijiji chimu, akahimangini na bhandu komi bhana malohi. Bhakajemi cha kutali,
bhakajamalili, bhakapwaghaje, “Yesu! Bambo utubhonila chiha!”
Yesu paakabhaweni, akabhapwaghile, “Njenda mkalilangia kwa bhapenganyambiku.” Pabhakabhi mwindela bhakajendaje, bhakalamike.
Jumu wabhu paaliweni kubha alamike, akakelawiki kwaka Yesu koni akundumbalya Chapanga kwa kujamalila.
Akalileki pahi palongi ja magholu ghaka Yesu koni akunchengulaje. Mundu jonihoju akabhi Msamalia.
Yesu akalalukile, “Bho, nga bhandu komi le bhabhalamike? Bho, tisa bhala bhabhi kwako?
Bho, ngacheabhonakini mundu jongi joakelawiki kundumbali Chapanga nambu ngeni ajoju pela?”
Bhela Yesu akumpwaghi mundu jola, “Ujemaje, ujendaje, uhobhalelu waku ukulamihe.”
Kuhika kwa Ukolongwa waka Chapanga
Chikahi chimu Mafalisayo bhakundaluki Yesu, “Bho, Ukolongwa waka Chapanga anauhika lile?” Yesu akabhayangike, “Ukolongwa waka Chapanga ngacheuhika kwa kubhonikana kwa mihu.
Nga jumu joanawezaje kupwagha, ‘Lingalyaje, ubhi pambane, au ubhi pala.’ Chakaka Ukolongwa waka Chapanga ubhi mkati jinu.”
Bhela Yesu akabhapwaghi bhabhulwa bhaki, “Machobha ghahika pamwitokulya kubhona lichobha limu pa machobha ghaka Mwana waka Mundu, nambu ngamwalibhone.
Bhandu bhampwaghila, ‘Ndingalya abhi kola!’ Au ‘Ndingalya abhi pambane!’ Nambu ngamwibhoka pambile na kubhajengalela.
Kwa ndandi ngati unang'anu wa chitobhi moubhonakela kunani na kumulika kutumbula upambala ghumu mbaka upambala ghongi, bhenibhela nde Mwana waka Mundu moayibhonakanya mu lichobha leanahikaje.
Nambu mangani ja mambu ghanihagha ghokapi anaang'ahakika namaa na kukanakika na bhandu bha kibheleku chenu.
Ngati mokwabheli pa machobha ghaka Nuhu, nde mokwibhelila pa machobha gha kuhika kwaka Mwana waka Mundu.

Machobha ghanighala bhandu bhakabhi bhakula na kunywa, bhakatoghula na kutoghuleka, mbaka lichobha lela Nuhu paajingala mu sitima ngolongwa jejilowakeka safina. Na panihapa iyula ngolongwa jakatonyiki na kubhakoma bhokapi.
Kwibya bhenibhela ngati mokwabheli pa machobha ghaka Lutu. Bhandu bhakabhi bhakula na kunywa, bhakalomba na kulombesa, bhakapanda imbeju na kuchenga.
Nambu lichobha Lutu paakabhokiki ku Sodoma, motu na maganga ghaghabhelela motu ghakahawiki pahi kuhuma kunani kumahunde na kubhakoma bhokapi.
Bhenibhela nde mokwibhelila lichobha lela Mwana waka Mundu paanahikaje.
“Mu Lichobha heli, mundu jokapi joayibya kunani ja nhwaghala ngaayihuluka kujingi munyumba na kutola hindu yaki. Bhelabhela mundu joayibya kungonda ngaikelabhuka kunyumba kutola chindu.
Mkombuka ghala ghaghumpatiki nhwanu waka Lutu.
Mundu jokapi joapala kuukengale womi waki, anauhoaje, nambu mundu jola joapala kuuhoa womi waki, anaukengalyaje.
Numpwaghila, ikilu heji, bhandu bhabheli bhibya bhaghoni pachitanda chimu, jumu ayitolakikaje na jongi kuhighalila.
Akambomba bhabheli bhibya bhapola mahunu papamu, jumu ayitolakikaje na jongi kuhighalila.
Bhandu bhabheli bhibya kungonda, jumu ayitolakikaje na jongi kuhighalila.”
Panihapa bhabhulwa bhaki bhakundalukile, “Bambo, bho, mambu ghanihagha ghitendakika kwako?” Yesu akabhayangiki, “Pandu papibya na ntuhi, panihapa nde payalibhongana ngwahe.”
